title: Box audit: xywh predictions, per-class thresholds, greedy matching
scenario: Annotator boxes exported as xywh are matched greedily (highest IoU first) to xyxy ground truth with per-class IoU thresholds; the report scores each annotator and gives per-class best-IoU localisation.

verified.why_correct: Pooling every annotator's predictions looks like a scoping slip, but the README defines localisation as the best IoU any annotator reaches, ignoring thresholds and matching. max(..., default=0.0) covers boxes nobody predicted (g10).
With exclusive right/bottom edges, x2 = x + w exactly. No ±1 is needed in this convention.

bugs.title: Matching takes the weakest overlap first
bugs.old: sorted(candidates(preds, gts), key=lambda c: c[0], reverse=True)
bugs.symptom: test_1 test_matches fails: on IMG-1 the pairs come out p01→g02, p02→g01, p03→g02 instead of p01→g01, p02→g02, p03→g01. All other pairs, the unmatched list and the annotator scores are unaffected.
bugs.why: Greedy matching has to start with the best overlap. In ascending order the weakest qualifying pair claims a box first. On IMG-1, ann-1's p02→g01 (0.720) gets accepted before p02→g02 (0.933), so p01 and p02 swap targets, and Ann-2's p03 lands on g02 (0.661) instead of g01 (0.960). Every prediction that matched still matches, so the unmatched list and the scores don't change.
hints: Compare p01's IoU with g01 and with g02. Which pairing did the code choose?
Look at the order candidates are processed in match().
probes: Why are tp/fp/fn identical under both orders in this data?
Construct a case where the wrong order changes the tp count.

bugs.title: Annotator ids not lower-cased
bugs.symptom: test_2 test_annotator_scores fails: the report lists five annotators, including 'ANN-3' (tp 1, fp 1, fn 9) and 'Ann-2' (tp 1, fp 0, fn 9), and ann-2/ann-3 drop to tp 4 and tp 3 (f1 0.471 and 0.429). Matches are unchanged.
bugs.why: The IMG-2 rows are exported as 'ANN-3' and IMG-1's p03 as 'Ann-2'. Without lower-casing they become separate annotators, and each one is charged with every ground-truth box as a possible miss.
hints: How many annotators does the report list, and how many should there be?
Compare how the loader cleans annotator ids with the README.
probes: Why did matches not change even though the ids were split?
What data change would have made this alter the matches too?

bugs.title: Pixel-inclusive +1 in the intersection
bugs.old:
iw = min(a.x2, b.x2) - max(a.x1, b.x1)
    ih = min(a.y2, b.y2) - max(a.y1, b.y1)
bugs.new:
iw = min(a.x2, b.x2) - max(a.x1, b.x1) + 1
    ih = min(a.y2, b.y2) - max(a.y1, b.y1) + 1
bugs.symptom: test_2 test_localization fails: {'car': 1.0, 'person': 0.984, 'sign': 0.776} instead of {'car': 0.971, 'person': 0.944, 'sign': 0.701}. Every class reads high, and matches and scores are unchanged.
bugs.why: The +1 belongs to inclusive pixel indexing. Here x2 is exclusive and area() has no +1, so the intersection is inflated against the union: exact matches score above 1 and every overlap reads high. No pair crosses a threshold, so matching is unchanged.
hints: Localisation is higher than it should be for every class. Compute IoU(p17, g07) by hand.
Check iou() against the coordinate convention in the README.
Remove the + 1 from iw and ih.
probes: Why can this version produce an IoU above 1?
Why did no match decision change? Which pairs came closest to a threshold?

context_qa.q: What does build_report compute, in order?
context_qa.a: It loads ground truth (xyxy) and predictions (xywh converted to xyxy), runs `match_all` to get pred→gt pairs, scores annotators from those pairs with `annotator_scores`, and computes `localization` from `best_iou_per_gt`, which doesn't use the pairs.
It groups predictions by `(image_id, annotator)` and ground truth by `image_id`, runs `match` for each group against that image's ground truth, and merges the resulting dicts.
A list of `(iou, pred_id, gt_id)` tuples for same-label pairs whose label is in THRESHOLDS and whose IoU is at least that label's threshold.

context_qa.q: How are fn and recall computed?
context_qa.a: `fn` is the total number of ground-truth boxes minus that annotator's matched predictions, and recall is tp ÷ total ground-truth boxes, because every annotator is assigned every image.

context_qa.q: Which rows does the loader skip?
context_qa.a: Rows where any of the coordinate columns is blank after trimming; `_numbers` returns None for them. In this data that's g11 and p23.
A frozen dataclass with `x1, y1, x2, y2` floats. `area` multiplies the clamped width and height, and `iou` returns 0.0 when the overlap width or height is not positive.
